title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must mount /boot with the nodev option.
check_content:
Verify that the "/boot" mount point has the "nodev" option is with the following command:

$ mount | grep '\s/boot\s'

/dev/sda2 on /boot type xfs (rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,seclabel,attr2,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=32k,noquota)

If the "/boot" file system does not have the "nodev" option set, this is a finding.
fixtext: Modify "/etc/fstab" to use the "nodev" option on the "/boot" directory.
VulnDiscussion: The only legitimate location for device files is the "/dev" directory located on the root partition. The only exception to this is chroot jails.
